findings: Admin creates second Supabase client — realtime block in admin/dashboard.astro does `const { createClient } = await import('@supabase/supabase-js')` instead of importing from src/lib/supabase.ts, violating the brief's explicit rule. Replace with `import { supabase } from '../../lib/supabase'`.

Toast race condition on status-change detection — both orders.astro and buyer/dashboard.astro can miss status-change toasts when two Postgres events arrive in quick succession (second handler sees allOrders already updated, so prevStatuses diff produces no changes). Add a debounce on the realtime callback.

Cart unavailability badge matching by alt text — checkCartAvailability matches DOM images by `imgEl.alt === item.title`, which fails for titles containing HTML-unsafe characters like quotes. Add a data-product-id attribute to cart item images and match by that instead.

Seller new-order flash depends on payload.eventType case — the orange border flash checks `payload.eventType === 'INSERT'` (uppercase). If the SDK ever delivers lowercase, the highlight silently disappears. Use `payload.eventType?.toUpperCase() === 'INSERT'`.

orders.astro doesn't use watchTable helper — the orders page subscription is built inline rather than via the shared watchTable utility, inconsistent with index, search, and cart. Refactor to watchTable(supabase, 'orders', callback) with a beforeunload cleanup via the returned channel handle.
